rendered_frame_timing.active_policy: Both endpoints must be active; mixed states go to excluded.transition. Excluded intervals remain in all. No time rebase, clamp or exclusion around normal save/load.
rendered_frame_timing.first_endpoint_policy: First endpoint establishes a baseline and produces no interval.

histogram_spec.percentiles: Nearest-rank histogram bin bounds, not exact sample percentiles. Overflow upper bound is the exact observed max.

rendered_frame_timing.phase_attribution: Entire interval uses the previous endpoint phase; phase-boundary intervals are counted without interpolation.
rendered_frame_timing.scope: Observed app frame-post-draw wall intervals, including normal gameplay save/load, autosave, diagnostics and presentation pacing. Not isolated GPU time, physical scanout, minimum hardware or a performance pass verdict. Native-export identity belongs to the containing runner report.
